summary: Lawrence "Lars" Bickford, 58, of Gunnison died while on a mountain bike ride on Signal Peak; his wife reported him missing ~5:27 p.m. Monday after a morning ride and a ~9 a.m. text saying he would be home by noon; the sheriff found his truck at the Signal Peak trails at Escalante; an initial phone ping was inaccurate; Western Mountain Rescue Team was called ~5:52 p.m.; an alternative phone locator led searchers to BLM Road 3211D, where team members found Bickford and his bike near the road ~1 a.m. Tuesday; no sign of violence, autopsy pending at publication.
location: Signal Peak, BLM Road 3211D near Escalante
responding_agency: Western Mountain Rescue Team + Gunnison County Sheriff
notes: Cause of death not determined in the published account; row dated at the missing/search date per convention.
